replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics and I have a complicated relationship. It's not my favorite subject, especially since I prefer literature and biology. However, I appreciate its practical uses, like in travel planning and budgeting for my part-time job. It can be frustrating, but I try to see it as a necessary skill.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. My neuroticism is high, so even simple equations can cause stress. I get anxious before exams or when faced with complex problems. Yoga helps me calm down, but I still find math challenging and often procrastinate.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor last semester to help with calculus. It was okay; the step-by-step explanations were useful, but I missed the human interaction. I felt less anxious with it, though. Sometimes it confused me more, but overall, it was a good supplement.
